# Third-Party Libraries

This folder contains all third-party libraries used by BTstack. The following table lists their source, license type,
and use.

## SBOM scope

This inventory is used to generate a source-distribution SBOM for BTstack. It covers the third-party components listed
below, including libraries used only by optional features, examples, or platform ports. BTstack itself is added by the
SBOM generator.

It does not describe a particular application or firmware build. External dependencies that are not bundled with the
source distribution, such as separately installed SDKs, system libraries, and build tools, are outside its scope.


## Inventory metadata

Paths and local license-file links are relative to this README. A license reference may point to a source file
containing the license or notice when there is no separate license file. License identifiers use SPDX notation
where identified. The custom license references are:

- `LicenseRef-Public-Domain`: public-domain notice in the linked source file.
- `LicenseRef-ST-SLA0047`: ST’s SLA0047 terms in the linked license file.

Version describes the upstream code, not a separate BTstack-maintained release. Revision records the upstream
commit separately from any BTstack changes. N/A means no upstream VCS revision is recorded for the website or
vendor distribution; Unknown means the version or revision has not been established. The notes identify comparison
bases and other remaining provenance limitations.
